player_prompt.intro:
Olija kulaba {N} maadili agenzebwa mu mpangilio.
Ku buli hatua, tiiya [accept] okukakasa maadili *ga kati*, oba [continue] okuleka kugenda osooke ku maadili agenzi.
Bw'otakkiriza, olija kulazimishwa okukakasa maadili ga mwisho.
Olija kuwangula (ekijja = 1) **yokka** bw'omaadili gwe olija kukakasa gwe maadili ga waggulu w'onna.

outcome.summary: Owadde mwadu {value} mu kufuna {draw_num}/{N}. Ebyatuukiza bya buli kika kye {best}. {result}
